kernel_policy.native-installer: BLOCKED unless /boot/candidates/installer/native-installer-runtime.ready and every dedicated native installer artifact exists
kernel_policy.native-recovery: BLOCKED unless /boot/candidates/recovery/native-recovery-runtime.ready and every dedicated native recovery artifact exists

handoff: Firmware -> GRUB2 BIOS/UEFI loader -> Spit Fire menu -> Jasper target manager -> Gates/selected boot target -> Multiboot2 -> Koronos -> hardware/driver discovery -> userspace

spitfire_artifacts.bios: SF0 MBR and SF2 stage-two binaries are assembled/linked and packaged; they are not the executable El Torito/UEFI ISO loader
spitfire_artifacts.uefi: sfu_uefi.c remains a source placeholder; GRUB2 performs the actual UEFI boot
spitfire_artifacts.menu: GRUB2 Spit Fire menu config hands off to /boot/jasper/jasper.cfg

runtime_candidates.activation: No native handoff until dedicated native init, filesystem/process services, CPL3/PID readiness and cold-boot acceptance are verified
